findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "citation_report_large" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Verify a bibliography. For every reference: exists, resolves, retracted/corrected/flagged, title/author/year match against the registered record, and a rule-der…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
